chosen_titles.rationale: Chapter 120C - Lobbying: the standalone, consolidated lobbying-disclosure chapter created by the 2006 NC State Government Ethics Act reform, housing lobbyist/principal registration, expenditure reporting, prohibitions, and enforcement.

notes: Chapter 138A (State Government Ethics Act) regulates covered officials/state employees, not lobbyists, so it is out of scope per the pass-1 prompt's scope rule. Chapter 120 (General Assembly) contained the pre-2006 Article 9A lobbying regime but post-reform lobbying lives entirely in 120C (consistent with the NC 2010 and NC 2015 prior bundles).
